summary: Bridalveil Creek (Yosemite): NPS campgrounds table + bvcamp + rec.gov 232453 + Esri. Closed early for 2026 (Aug 14, lightning damage to water/restrooms); normally Jul-early Sept. $36, reservation-only, rolling 2-week window (not 6 months), 14-night max. Catalog 106 sites; RV to 35 / trailer to 24 ft but only 16 sites take a 23-ft+ RV. Flush toilets + tap water. Not waterfront kept.
flags: STATUS: closed for the rest of 2026 since August 14, after a lightning strike damaged its potable water and restrooms (NPS, updated November 10, 2026). It is now off season anyway; no NPS word yet on whether repairs are done for 2027. Not written as temporarily_closed. Re-check before the July 2027 opening.
BOOKING WINDOW: 2 weeks ahead (rec.gov reservationWindow 14 Days; NPS '2 weeks ahead'), overriding the federal row's 180 days. Written as window_opens_days 14.

Site fit: the NPS limits are 35 ft RV / 24 ft trailer, which passes a 23-ft rig. But rec.gov allows an RV of 23 ft or more at only 16 of 106 sites: 008, 019, 024, 031, 032, 108 (24 ft), 043, 061, 102 (25), 081, 091, 092 (23), 074, 086 (30), 069, 072 (35). Not a drop; noted in sites.note.
Site count: rec.gov catalog 106 (horse sites moved to their own listing 'Bridalveil Creek Horse Campsites'); NPS table 110. Wrote 106.

Horse/group: the horse sites are now a separate rec.gov facility, and the group sites are tent-only. The general loops A-C are separate; it stays a general campground (the existing curation_note covers it).
FACILITIES CORRECTION: stored vault_toilets true -> false (NPS: tap-water campgrounds 'have regular restrooms'; rec.gov flush toilets). No dump on site (notice points to Wawona).
Phone: stored '' -> (209) 375-9535 (Wawona campground office; rec.gov and nps.gov bvcamp). Websites confirmed.
Pin 37.66355,-119.62362 is ~160 m west of the site centroid (37.66348,-119.62179): fine.
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: Bridalveil Creek runs through the meadow ~70 m NW of the nearest sites, behind forest.
